commit.subject: LU-17000 compat: Fix resource leak in ll_shrinker_alloc
commit.message:
LU-17000 compat: Fix resource leak in ll_shrinker_alloc

ll_shrinker is allocated early. If shrinker_alloc() fails
it leaves ll_shrinker dangling on exit. This patch fixes
leak on a fail path while allocating 'struct shrinker'

CoverityID: 504221 ("Resource leak")
Fixes: 1d6cdb63f3a ("LU-18175 lustre: back port shrinker debugfs support")
Signed-off-by: Arshad Hussain <arshad.hussain@aeoncomputing.com>
Change-Id: Ica312c9a86558f70247a206d8733f06e3308f5eb
